article.title: OBSBOT新攝影機把AI追蹤與鏡頭控制整合
article.title_en: OBSBOT adds AI tracking and camera controls in new Tail models
article.summary: OBSBOT介紹Tail 2 ADV及Tail Air 2，把AI主體追蹤與電動鏡頭控制用於不同拍攝環境。
article.summary_en: OBSBOT introduced Tail 2 ADV and Tail Air 2, combining subject tracking and motorized camera control for different production settings.
highlights: Tail Air 2配備1吋感光元件及AI影像處理晶片。
AI Director Grids把追蹤、預設及Launchpad放進同一控制介面。
highlights_en: Tail Air 2 has a one-inch sensor and an AI image-processing chip.
AI Director Grids brings tracking, presets and Launchpad into one interface.
article.why: 直播與活動拍攝可把跟隨主體的操作交予攝影機，製作團隊可決定哪些鏡位仍需人員持續控制。
article.why_en: Live-production teams can decide which shots suit automated following and which still require continuous camera operation.
article.next_step: 以一段講者走動的活動鏡位列出追蹤、預設切換及人工接手需求，再向供應商確認現場控制方式。
article.next_step_en: Map tracking, preset switches and manual takeover for a moving speaker, then confirm the venue control setup with the supplier.
article.detail: 公司在11月19日紐約活動介紹新產品，相關通訊稿於11月20日發布。Tail 2 ADV面向大型場地及現場活動，Tail Air 2則結合感光元件與AI影像處理。製作團隊可先按鏡位距離、光線及主體移動方式整理需求，再比較自動追蹤與人工控制如何配合，安排實際拍攝的分工。
article.detail_en: The New York introduction took place on November 19; the wire release followed on November 20. ADV targets large venues and events, while Air 2 combines sensor and AI processing. Compare distance, lighting and movement requirements before assigning automated and manual roles.
